cues.en: -: In this video, I want to talk a little bit more about probability functions.
cues.zh: 這部影片想進一步談談機率函數。

cues.en: So, probability mass functions and probability density functions.
cues.zh: 也就是機率質量函數和機率密度函數。

cues.en: Now, as you know from the previous video, a probability density function is more of like a theoretical analytic concept, and a probability mass function is something,
cues.zh: 從前一部影片已經知道，機率密度函數比較像理論、解析的概念，而機率質量函數，

cues.en: is a probability function of a discrete number of items.
cues.zh: 是離散數量項目的機率函數。

cues.en: Now, things get a little bit more complicated when we start working with computers, because with computers, we cannot actually represent a true analog signal,
cues.zh: 開始使用電腦時，事情會稍微複雜一點，因為電腦無法真正表示類比訊號，

cues.en: the way that we can imagine it in the real world and write it down on paper with integral science and so on.
cues.zh: 不像我們能在真實世界中想像，或在紙上用積分符號等等寫出來。

cues.en: So in some sense, on computers, you're always working with probability mass functions, and anything that you call a probability density function is actually just an estimate
cues.zh: 所以某種意義上，在電腦上總是在處理機率質量函數，而稱為機率密度函數的東西，其實只是

cues.en: of a real probability density function.
cues.zh: 真正機率密度函數的估計。

cues.en: Okay so with that, I wanna start by actually rerunning the code from the Marble Jar experiment that we did in the previous coding videos.
cues.zh: 先從重新執行前幾部程式影片的彈珠罐實驗開始。

cues.en: So, Its a couple videos ago.
cues.zh: 也就是幾部影片前的內容。

cues.en: And I've already ran it over here, and that produced this plot.
cues.zh: 這裡已經執行過，產生這張圖。

cues.en: And this is just to remind you about the difference between probability and proportion, but also to highlight a case where we have a very clear probability mass function
cues.zh: 只是提醒機率與比例的差異，也強調一種非常清楚的機率質量函數情況，

cues.en: because in our little universe here of that jar, there are only three distinct events.
cues.zh: 因為罐子這個小宇宙，只有三種不同事件。

cues.en: And so the probability function has to be a probability mass function, because there is a finite number of discrete events, there's only three possible things that can happen.
cues.zh: 所以機率函數必定是機率質量函數，因為離散事件的數量有限，只有三種可能結果。

cues.en: So that gives us this mass function, which is drawn out here by these blue horizontal lines.
cues.zh: 這裡的藍色水平線畫出的，就是這個質量函數。

cues.en: Okay so.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And now what I'm gonna do here in this code, is compute an empirical probability function, that's going to be an estimate of a probability density function.
cues.zh: 接著這段程式要計算一個經驗機率函數，作為機率密度函數的估計。

cues.en: So what I'm doing is, creating a time series signal.
cues.zh: 做法是建立時間序列訊號。

cues.en: So, this is for data TS is time series, and I'm just creating two of them.
cues.zh: dataTS 的 TS 代表 time series，也就是時間序列，我會建立兩組。

cues.en: So, data time series one and time series two.
cues.zh: 也就是時間序列資料一和時間序列資料二。

cues.en: Now, as I've mentioned, we can actually create a continuous signal on a computer, but we can create a discrete signal
cues.zh: 如前面提過，我們其實可以在電腦上建立連續訊號，但可以建立離散訊號，

cues.en: that just is sampled very highly.
cues.zh: 只是取樣非常密集。

cues.en: So it's sort of, you know, this is actually discrete, but we are pretending for the moment that this is a continuous analog signal.
cues.zh: 所以它其實是離散的，但暫時假裝這是連續類比訊號。

cues.en: And I'm creating this as Brownian noise, which I introduced you to previously in this course.
cues.zh: 我會使用這門課之前介紹過的布朗雜訊來建立。

cues.en: So it's just, random numbers that are distributed around zero, evenly distributed around zero.
cues.zh: 也就是分布在 0 周圍、在 0 兩側均勻分布的隨機數。

cues.en: We take the sign of those random numbers, and then we take the cumulative sum of the signs, which is just the cumulative sum of random plus ones and minus ones.
cues.zh: 取這些隨機數的正負號，再取正負號的累積總和，也就是隨機 +1 和 −1 的累積總和。

cues.en: And actually to create Brownian noise, you don't technically need this sign.
cues.zh: 其實建立布朗雜訊，技術上不一定需要 sign。

cues.en: You can try it also without the sign, and then taking the cumulative sum over these random numbers.
cues.zh: 也可以試著不使用 sign，直接對這些隨機數取累積總和。

cues.en: Okay so, here we see what they look like.
cues.zh: 好，看看它們的樣子。

cues.en: Let's see, I'll run this code here.
cues.zh: 執行這段程式。

cues.en: So, this is what these two Brownian random motion time series look like.
cues.zh: 這就是這兩組布朗隨機運動時間序列的樣子。

cues.en: They kind of go up and down randomly, and of course you can run this multiple times and they're always going to look different.
cues.zh: 它們隨機上下變動，當然可以重複執行，每次都會不同。

cues.en: Sometimes they might happen to look similar to each other, but it's purely by chance.
cues.zh: 有時也許剛好彼此相似，但純粹是偶然。

cues.en: Okay. And now the thing is, we cannot actually compute a probability function directly on these data.
cues.zh: 現在的問題是，不能直接對這些資料計算機率函數。

cues.en: Instead, that's because these are either interval or precision data or ratio data.
cues.zh: 因為它們是區間資料，或者有精度的資料，或比率資料。

cues.en: Instead, what we have to do is discretize these data, so therefore, I'm going to discretize using histograms.
cues.zh: 必須先離散化，所以我會使用直方圖。

cues.en: All of this code you've seen before.
cues.zh: 這些程式你都看過。

cues.en: And then I'm plotting the histograms, and here I'm plotting them as lines.
cues.zh: 接著畫直方圖，這裡用線條來畫。

cues.en: And that's to make sure that we can see both of these histograms on top of each other on the same plot.
cues.zh: 這是為了確保兩張直方圖疊在同一張圖上，仍然都看得見。

cues.en: Now, in this particular case, it happened to work out that this would actually look pretty good with bars instead of lines, but that's just because the distributions happen to be
cues.zh: 這次剛好改用長條也會很好看，但只是因為兩個分布剛好

cues.en: far apart from each other.
cues.zh: 彼此距離很遠。

cues.en: It's just the way the random noise worked out.
cues.zh: 純粹是這次隨機雜訊的結果。

cues.en: We can run this again, and they might have.
cues.zh: 再執行一次，也許會……

cues.en: Yeah so, here would be a case where the bars wouldn't really work.
cues.zh: 對，這裡就不太適合用長條。

cues.en: Anyway, this is supposed to be now an estimate of the probability density function here.
cues.zh: 總之，這裡現在是機率密度函數的估計。

cues.en: Now why am I calling this a probability function and not a proportion function?
cues.zh: 為什麼我稱它為機率函數，而不是比例函數？

cues.en: Because maybe you're looking at this and you're saying, Hey Mike, come on, these are, this is not probability, these are proportions.
cues.zh: 也許你看著這個會說：「Mike，拜託，這不是機率，是比例。」

cues.en: This is the empirical proportion of data that has, you know, this range between, you know, or around minus 50, whatever it is, these bin boundaries end up being,
cues.zh: 這是在某個範圍，例如 −50 附近，不管區間邊界實際是多少，資料所占的實驗比例。

cues.en: to which I reply that you are technically correct.
cues.zh: 我的回答是，嚴格來說你是對的。

cues.en: But a situation like this, we can actually interpret proportion or probability, depending on how exactly we ask the question.
cues.zh: 但在這種情況下，可以解讀成比例，也可以解讀成機率，取決於問題的精確問法。

cues.en: So, here's how I'm going to justify this being a probability function.
cues.zh: 接下來說明，我如何合理地把它稱為機率函數。

cues.en: Let's say, we would pick a data point totally at random from this blue time series.
cues.zh: 假設從這條藍色時間序列，完全隨機挑選一個資料點。

cues.en: So, we're not caring about which time point it is.
cues.zh: 不在意是哪個時間點。

cues.en: We're not gonna just take the first time point.
cues.zh: 不是只取第一個時間點。

cues.en: We just pick any single time point at random, and we look at the value of that time point.
cues.zh: 而是隨機取任意單一時間點，再看該點的值。

cues.en: Then we have a 0.0
cues.zh: 那麼機率是 0.0……

cues.en: 4.3% chance at random of picking a value that is minus 35.05.
cues.zh: 隨機挑到 −35.05 這個值的機率為 4.3%。

cues.en: So that's the way that you can interpret this as a probability function, even though I'm kind of computing it as an empirical proportion function.
cues.zh: 這就是將它解讀為機率函數的方式，即使計算上比較像經驗比例函數。

cues.en: And again, this highlights that probability and proportion are easy concepts to confuse with each other, because although they are distinct concepts,
cues.zh: 這再次凸顯，機率與比例很容易混淆，因為雖然概念不同，

cues.en: they can actually overlap.
cues.zh: 卻可能重疊。

cues.en: Sometimes they give the same answer, depending on how exactly you phrase the question.
cues.zh: 有時會得到相同答案，取決於問題的精確問法。

cues.en: So here we saw, we knew that the, we knew exactly what the probability was, so there was a clear distinction between probability and proportion.
cues.zh: 這裡，我們確切知道機率是多少，因此機率和比例有明確區別。

cues.en: And here I'm claiming that probability is the same as proportion depending on how you set up the question, depending on how you define your experiment here.
cues.zh: 而這裡我主張，機率和比例相同，取決於如何設定問題、如何定義實驗。

cues.en: So let's start, I'm gonna import these modules, but actually I'm gonna start by going back to this code from a couple of videos ago,
cues.zh: 先開始，我會匯入這些模組，但其實先回到幾部影片前的程式，

cues.en: where we looked at the proportion versus the probability of marbles that were randomly mixed into a jar.
cues.zh: 當時比較的是，隨機混合在罐子中的彈珠，其比例與機率。

cues.en: So, this was a clear case of a probability mass function.
cues.zh: 這是很明確的機率質量函數例子。

cues.en: And remember from the video that the difference between a probability mass function and a probability density function is that, a probability mass function is what you compute when you have a finite number,
cues.zh: 記得影片中說過，機率質量函數和機率密度函數的差別，在於質量函數是對有限數量，

cues.en: typically a small number of discrete events or discrete possibilities, which is definitely the case here.
cues.zh: 通常是少量的離散事件或離散可能性計算，這裡肯定符合。

cues.en: Our little universe of this jar, has only three different colors of marbles.
cues.zh: 罐子這個小宇宙，只有三種顏色的彈珠。

cues.en: So, we compute a probability mass function.
cues.zh: 所以計算的是機率質量函數。

cues.en: And a probability density function, is more of like a continuous analytic or almost a more theoretical phenomenon.
cues.zh: 機率密度函數則比較像連續、解析，幾乎是更理論性的概念。

cues.en: And that you would use when you have like a, an infinite range of variables, or at least a very large range of variables with arbitrary precision that would be for interval or ratio data.
cues.zh: 用於變數有無限範圍，或至少有很大的範圍且可以有任意精度的情況，也就是區間或比率資料。

cues.en: Now, the thing about working with computers is we cannot truly generate a probability density function, an empirical probability density function.
cues.zh: 但使用電腦時，無法真正產生機率密度函數，也就是經驗機率密度函數。

cues.en: And that's because we cannot really represent arbitrary precision data on computers.
cues.zh: 因為電腦無法真正表示任意精度的資料。

cues.en: So instead what we do is, what I'm going to do here, is generate a technically discrete signal, but I'm just using a lot of time points.
cues.zh: 所以這裡會產生一個技術上離散的訊號，但使用很多時間點。

cues.en: And so we're gonna pretend like this is a continuous signal and compute an empirical probability function.
cues.zh: 假裝它是連續訊號，再計算經驗機率函數。

cues.en: Okay so, the way that I do this here, is by generating what's called Brownian noise.
cues.zh: 做法是產生所謂的布朗雜訊。

cues.en: And I've introduced you to this already.
cues.zh: 前面已經介紹過。

cues.en: But essentially to create Brownian noise, you take the cumulative sum of a bunch of random plus ones and minus ones, and I'm getting those plus ones and minus ones
cues.zh: 基本上，建立布朗雜訊，就是對一批隨機的 +1 和 −1 取累積總和，而這些 +1、−1，

cues.en: by taking the sign of a normally distributed set of numbers.
cues.zh: 來自一組常態分布數字的正負號。

cues.en: Now turns out, you don't actually need the sign function.
cues.zh: 其實不需要 sign 函式。

cues.en: You can compute Brownian motion just by taking the cumulative sum of normally distributed random numbers.
cues.zh: 直接對常態分布隨機數取累積總和，也能計算布朗運動。

cues.en: As long as the random numbers are evenly distributed above and below zero, you're going to end up with Brownian motion.
cues.zh: 只要隨機數在 0 的上下兩側均衡分布，最後就會得到布朗運動。

cues.en: Okay so, then we see what they look like.
cues.zh: 好，看看它們的樣子。

cues.en: I'm gonna plot them.
cues.zh: 我要把它們畫出來。

cues.en: And then below that, I'm going to discretize these using histograms and then plot the histograms using lines.
cues.zh: 下面則使用直方圖離散化，再用線條畫出直方圖。

cues.en: Now these are. Okay so, here we see the the two time series that I'm generating from Brownian noise, and these are the probability distributions.
cues.zh: 好，這裡看到產生的兩條布朗雜訊時間序列，而這些是機率分布。

cues.en: Now, it's important to keep in mind that these are not true probability density functions.
cues.zh: 要記住，這些不是真正的機率密度函數。

cues.en: These are our estimates of probability densities based on these data which are really discrete, and we also have to discretize them further
cues.zh: 這些是根據實際上離散的資料所估計的機率密度，而且還要進一步離散化，

cues.en: by creating this histogram.
cues.zh: 也就是建立這個直方圖。

cues.en: So, this is our empirical estimate of a probability density function.
cues.zh: 所以這是機率密度函數的經驗估計。

cues.en: Now, maybe you're looking at the code, maybe you're thinking carefully about what you've learned in the previous few videos, and you're thinking, hey Mike, this is not a probability density,
cues.zh: 也許你看著程式，仔細思考前幾部影片學到的內容，心想：「Mike，這不是機率密度，

cues.en: this is an empirical proportion plot.
cues.zh: 這是實驗比例圖。

cues.en: You're just plotting the proportion of data points that fall between certain bins given by this histogram function.
cues.zh: 只是把直方圖函式所指定區間內的資料點比例畫出來。

cues.en: How is this probability?
cues.zh: 怎麼會是機率？」

cues.en: Well, it's a very good observation, and my answer is that it depends on exactly how you're thinking about the probability in this case.
cues.zh: 觀察得很好。我的回答是，要看你如何理解這個情境中的機率。

cues.en: So let's say we would go from, so take this orange time series here.
cues.zh: 例如，取這條橘色時間序列。

cues.en: Let's imagine we pick a time point at random.
cues.zh: 想像隨機挑選一個時間點。

cues.en: So, totally randomly just draw a data point from any one of these time points.
cues.zh: 完全隨機地從任一時間點抽出一個資料點。

cues.en: And we look at the value of that, of the data at that time point.
cues.zh: 再看那個時間點的資料值。

cues.en: So now, based on this probability plot, this function, we can say, that you have a 4% chance
cues.zh: 根據這張機率圖、這個函數，可以說，有 4% 的機率，

cues.en: of picking a value at, you know, minus 32 or whatever these bin boundaries are.
cues.zh: 選到 −32，或不管這裡區間邊界是多少附近的值。

cues.en: So, if you think of the experiment that way, then this is actually a probability function.
cues.zh: 如果這樣思考實驗，它其實就是機率函數。

cues.en: This is telling us the probability of getting a certain value at when we draw a time point at random.
cues.zh: 它告訴我們，隨機抽取時間點時，得到特定數值的機率。

cues.en: But this also does highlight some of the confusion between proportion and probability, because although these two terms refer to different concepts,
cues.zh: 但這也凸顯機率與比例的一些混淆，因為這兩個詞雖然指向不同概念，

cues.en: depending on how you're thinking about the experiment, depending on how you ask the question, they can be overlapping.
cues.zh: 卻可能因為對實驗的理解和提問方式而重疊。

cues.en: So, here was the case from this other video about drawing marbles from a jar.
cues.zh: 這是另一部影片中，從罐子抽彈珠的情況。

cues.en: Here's a case where we could clearly differentiate probability and proportion.
cues.zh: 在那裡可以清楚區分機率和比例。

cues.en: So, you saw that they were similar to each other, but definitely not the same.
cues.zh: 可以看到，它們相似，但肯定不相同。

cues.en: And in this case, I'm saying that the probability and the proportion are the same, because of the way that I am asking the question here, which is if I drew a
cues.zh: 而這裡，我說機率和比例相同，是因為問法是：如果從

cues.en: time point at random from this orange line, then this is the probability that I would draw a particular value.
cues.zh: 橘色線條隨機抽取一個時間點，這就是抽到特定數值的機率。
